The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market. [1] It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India. [2]

promises.opening: welcome to the Sun Pharma's Q2 FY27 Financial Results Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star and then zero on your touchtone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Dr. Abhishek Sharma, Vice President and Head of Investor Relations and Strategic Projects. Thank you, and over to you, sir. Abhishek Sharma: Thank you. Good evening, and a warm welcome to our second quarter FY27 earnings call. I'm Abhishek from the Sun Pharma Investor Relations team. We hope you have received the Q2 financials, the press release and the earnings presentation that was sent out earlier in the day. These are also available on our website. We have with us Mr. Dilip Shanghvi, Chairman; Mr. Kirti Ganorkar, Managing Director; Ms. Jayashree Satagopan, CFO; and Mr. Richard Ascroft, CEO, North America. Today, the team will provide an update on the financial performance and business highlights for the quarter, pipeline updates and respond to any questions that you may have. We will refer to the consolidated financials during management comments. The call recording and call transcript will also be put on our website shortly. The Organon acquisition is subject to satisfaction of the remaining customary closing conditions and is on track to close by early 2027. Organon has already announced their corresponding quarter results. Since Organon remains a separate public listed company, we will not be taking any questions today regarding Organon's business performance. The discussion today might include certain forward-looking statements, and these must be viewed in conjunction with the risks that our business faces. You are requested to ask two questions in the initial round. I also request all of you to kindly send in your questions that may remain unanswered today. I will now hand over the call to our CFO, Ms. Jayashree Satagopan. Jayashree Satagopan: Welcome, and thank you all for joining us for the earnings call after the announcement of the financial results for the second quarter FY27. The financials are already with you. Let me take you through the key consolidated financials. During the second quarter of FY27, sales were at INR1,61,000 million, registering a growth of 11.8% vis-a-vis Q2 FY26. Gross margin was at 80.8% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, largely on account of a better product mix and favorable currency tailwinds. Sun Pharma Q2 FY27 Earnings Call Transcript 06:30 pm October 30, 2026 Corporate Office : Sun House, 201 B/1, Western Express Highway, Goregaon (E), Mumbai - 400063 For further updates and specific queries, please visit www.sunpharma.com or feel free to contact Abhishek Sharma, +91 22 43242929, abhi.sharma@sunpharma.com, Anand Kadkol, +91 22 43245373, anand.kadkol@sunpharma.com, EBITDA for the quarter was INR47,439 million, an increase of 4.8% over Q2 last year. EBITDA margins came in at 29.3%. EBITDA margins are lower year-on-year. Please note that Q2 FY26 had some benefit from lenalidomide sales. Adjusted for lenalidomide, EBITDA growth has outpaced revenue growth. Forex gain for the quarter was INR785 million, which is lower than Q2 of last year. Reported net profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR19,885 million, while adjusted net profit for the quarter was INR31,620 million. EPS for the quarter was INR8.3 per share. Exceptional items for the second quarter includes provision towards a litigation settlement and on account of Organon-related acquisition costs. Effective tax rate for the quarter was 28.3% versus 24.7% in Q2 FY26. Balance sheet continues to be strong with a net cash of USD3.3 billion at the consolidated level. Now let me take you through the half yearly performance. For the first half, sales were at INR3,12,836 mill
